ios.desc:
Stay informed in minutes, not hours. Pidgeon uses AI to read hundreds of news articles and deliver clear, concise summaries, so you get the full picture without the noise.

No clickbait. No clutter. Just the news that matters to you.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE PIDGEON
- Catch up on the day's news in under 5 minutes
- Get multiple perspectives on every story, not just one source
- Never miss important updates: stories evolve as news breaks
- Focus on topics and regions you actually care about
- Build a daily reading habit with streak tracking and insights

KEY FEATURES
- AI-powered summaries combining multiple trusted sources
- Smart Feed with sections: Top Stories, Just In, For You, and more
- 10 categories: Tech, Business, Sports, Politics, Science, and more
- Coverage from 12 countries including US, UK, Canada, and Australia
- Timeline view for chronological browsing
- Daily digests organized by category
- Search stories by keyword, category, or region
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
- Reading activity insights: stories read, time saved, weekly trends
- Block topics or public figures you don't want to see
- Clean, ad-free, distraction-free reading experience
- Available in 10 languages

PIDGEON PRO
Unlock the full experience:
- Bookmarks: Save stories to your personal library
- Unlimited reading: No daily caps, no restrictions
- Audio digests: Listen to podcast-style news briefings on the go
- Offline access: Read anywhere, even without internet

LIFETIME ACCESS AVAILABLE
- One-time purchase for unlimited access
- All PRO features included forever
- No recurring payments
- Family Sharing supported

PERFECT FOR
- Busy professionals who need efficient news updates
- Commuters who prefer listening to audio digests
- Anyone tired of clickbait and sensationalized headlines
- News enthusiasts who want multiple perspectives in one place

Download Pidgeon and transform how you stay informed.

Your subscription automatically renews unless turned off at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage subscriptions in Settings > Apple ID.

Questions? support@pidgeon.news
Privacy: https://pidgeon.news/privacy
Terms: https://pidgeon.news/terms

quotes.text:
Hey everyone! I'm excited to share Pidgeon, a news app I've built that uses AI to deliver concise summaries of trending stories from around the world.

Key Features:

AI-powered summaries of trending stories
 Clean, modern interface focused on readability
 International coverage with country-specific trends
 Smart categorization (Tech, Business, Science, etc.)
 Daily digest of the most important stories
 Quick access to original sources
The app is designed to help you stay informed without getting overwhelmed. Instead of endless scrolling through news feeds, Pidgeon gives you concise, AI-generated summaries of what's trending, with links to full articles if you want to dive deeper.

What makes Pidgeon different:

No ads or clickbait
Privacy-focused (no account required)
Customizable filters for countries and categories
Smart reader view for articles
Topic blocking to avoid unwanted content
Available now on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/pidgeon-smart-trending-news/id6736756531

Web Landing Page: https://pidgeon.news/
